svg.title: EffiPed end-to-end multi-camera pedestrian tracking architecture
svg.desc: Four synchronized camera streams pass through a shared ConvNeXt V2 backbone, P2 and P3 feature fusion, CenterNet pedestrian detection, RoIAlign and four body-part strips, Coordinate Attention descriptor fusion, BoT-SORT temporal association, cross-camera gallery matching, and an analyst identity-review interface. The diagram also shows the detection, attention fusion, mutual-visibility cosine, triplet with cross-batch memory, and ArcFace training equations.

g.text: One shared visual backbone carries a person from pixels
Joint detection · local tracking · part-aware re-identification · analyst-in-the-loop review

g.aria-label: RoIAlign and four body-part identity features
BoT-SORT tracking and global gallery matching
